arguments.help: Explicit run output directory (writes all run artifacts here). If omitted, MPML creates results_archive/<gen>_<variant>__<timestamp>/.
Optional generation consistency hint (gen1|gen2). Must match selected variant semantics if provided.
Canonical experiment variant (A|B|C|D|E|F). Precedence: --experiment-variant > EXPERIMENT_VARIANT env > default A.
Experiment RNG seed. Precedence: --experiment-seed > EXPERIMENT_SEED env > default (42).

Behavioral Surface to use for this run. Precedence: --behavioral-surface > BEHAVIORAL_SURFACE env > 'trend_vol'. Available: ['persistent', 'reactive_jpy', 'trend_vol']. Trend/Vol (trend_vol) is the default and preserves existing run behaviour.
Generate recommendations_per_pair.parquet from pair-scoped walk-forward evidence.
Return only the top N recommendations ordered by the default recommendation policy (sharpe_rank_v1). If omitted, all recommendations are returned. N must be a positive integer.

Evaluate only this strategy ID. Repeatable: --strategy TF4 --strategy MR42. When omitted, the default evaluation scope from the active EvaluationPolicy is used (backward-compatible). IDs are validated against the Strategy Registry. Available: ['MR1', 'MR2', 'MR3', 'MR32', 'MR42', 'MR5', 'TF1', 'TF2', 'TF3', 'TF4', 'TF5']
Override the TrendFollowing representative used by PhaseAware for this run. Must be a Strategy Registry TrendFollowing ID, e.g. TF2. May be provided at most once.
Override the MeanReversion representative used by PhaseAware for this run. Must be a Strategy Registry MeanReversion ID, e.g. MR2. May be provided at most once.
Enable verbose debug output: [AWARENESS], [TRAINING DIAGNOSTICS], [DL FEATURE USAGE], and other detailed per-fold diagnostics that are suppressed by default for concise normal output.

Opt-in: write dl_conditional_portfolio_timeline.csv (per pair/fold/test-bar realized dynamic-selector portfolio outcomes with dl_available) to the run output directory. Disabled by default; does not change strategy behavior.

env.name: ACTIVE_PAIRS
env.semantics: Comma-separated pair names; values are stripped and uppercased. Empty selects all pairs. The import-time filter and later metadata inference also read the process environment.

env.name: BEHAVIORAL_STATE_ID
env.semantics: Stripped at the runtime read; blank becomes unset. Also snapshotted by src.dl_config for canonical identity helpers.

env.name: BEHAVIORAL_SURFACE
env.semantics: CLI --behavioral-surface takes precedence; otherwise stripped environment value, then trend_vol.

env.name: BEHAVIORAL_SURFACE_ID
env.semantics: Empty string becomes unset; part of canonical behavioral identity.

env.name: BEHAVIORAL_SURFACE_VERSION
env.semantics: Empty string becomes unset; part of canonical behavioral identity.

env.name: DL_FEATURE_SET
env.semantics: Snapshotted in main.DL_SIGNAL_SURFACE; a runtime check also tests whether the environment value is blank when resolving an artifact.

env.name: DL_MODEL
env.semantics: Snapshotted into main.DL_SIGNAL_SURFACE.

env.name: DL_PREDICTION_ARTIFACT_PATH
env.semantics: src.dl_config snapshots this at import. If unset (not empty), DL_SIGNALS_CUBE_PATH is used; main.py also reads it at runtime.

env.name: DL_REGIME
env.semantics: Snapshotted into main.DL_SIGNAL_SURFACE.

env.name: DL_SIGNALS_CUBE_PATH
env.semantics: Legacy path alias used only if DL_PREDICTION_ARTIFACT_PATH is unset. An empty primary value suppresses this alias.

env.name: DL_SIGNALS_ENABLED
env.semantics: Only case-insensitive exact text true enables; 1, yes, on, empty, and other values are false.

env.name: DL_SURFACE_FEATURE_SET
env.semantics: Snapshotted in the legacy DL surface selector.

env.name: DL_SURFACE_MODEL
env.semantics: Snapshotted in the legacy DL surface selector.

env.name: DL_SURFACE_REGIME
env.semantics: Snapshotted in the legacy DL surface selector.

env.name: DL_SURFACE_TARGET_HORIZON
env.semantics: Parsed with int() when the legacy DL surface is imported; malformed input fails import.

env.name: EXPERIMENT_GENERATION
env.semantics: CLI hint takes precedence; when supplied, it must agree with the selected variant.

env.name: EXPERIMENT_SEED
env.semantics: CLI seed wins. Environment text is stripped; blank uses 42 and malformed nonempty text raises ValueError.

env.name: EXPERIMENT_VARIANT
env.semantics: CLI value takes precedence; otherwise environment value, then A.

env.name: EXPORT_SELECTOR_STATE_TIMELINE
env.semantics: Case-insensitive 1, true, yes, or on are true; every other value is false.

env.name: MIN_DL_TRAIN_COVERAGE_PCT
env.semantics: Parsed with float() when main is imported; malformed input fails import. Preflight invokes the same converter.

env.name: MPML_ARTIFACT_SOURCE
env.semantics: Stripped non-empty value supplies artifact-source metadata when artifact metadata is absent.

env.name: MPML_AUTO_ANALYZE
env.semantics: Case-insensitive 1, true, yes, or on are true; every other value is false.

env.name: MPML_BROKER_DATA_DIR
env.semantics: Trimmed and expanded when constructing a broker_csv pipeline; blank uses the sibling-repository default.

env.name: MPML_DATA_SOURCE
env.semantics: Trimmed and lowercased; supported values are yfinance and broker_csv. Invalid values raise ValueError.

env.name: MPML_END_DATE
env.semantics: Snapshotted as a string when main is imported.

env.name: MPML_EVALUATION_PAIR_FAMILY
env.semantics: Stripped non-empty value supplies evaluation-pair-family metadata when artifact metadata is absent.

env.name: MPML_FEATURE_SURFACE
env.semantics: Stripped non-empty value supplies feature-surface metadata before the DL surface fallback.

env.name: MPML_OUTPUT_DIR
env.semantics: CLI --output-dir wins. Also supplies the output-name hint used by imputation-awareness inference.

env.name: MPML_REVISION
env.semantics: Optional revision/provenance value.

env.name: MPML_RUNS_ROOT
env.semantics: Used as the parent for generated run output paths when no explicit output directory is selected.

env.name: MPML_SELECTOR_TRACE_PAIR
env.semantics: Pair selector for optional single-bar trace output; only used with MPML_SELECTOR_TRACE_PATH.

env.name: MPML_SELECTOR_TRACE_PATH
env.semantics: Enables optional selector tracing for the matching pair and timestamp.

env.name: MPML_SELECTOR_TRACE_TIMESTAMP
env.semantics: Timestamp selector for optional single-bar trace output.

env.name: MPML_SENTIMENT_SURFACE
env.semantics: Stripped surface value; supported normalized values are sentiment, no_sentiment, and none.

env.name: MPML_START_DATE
env.semantics: Snapshotted as a string when main is imported.

env.name: MPML_TRAINING_PAIR_FAMILY
env.semantics: Stripped non-empty value supplies training-pair-family metadata when artifact metadata is absent.

env.name: MSML_REGIME
env.semantics: Trimmed and uppercased; fallback depends on the selected behavioral surface and resolved state.

env.name: OVERLAP_ONLY
env.semantics: Case-insensitive 1, true, yes, or on are true; every other value is false.

rules.summary: Configured pair names are not in the supported pair universe.
Arguments are not accepted by the MPML command-line parser.
The primary prediction artifact setting suppresses its legacy alias.
The explicitly configured prediction artifact does not exist.
A DL boolean value looks truthy but is parsed as false.
An environment value cannot be parsed or is unsupported.
The requested generation conflicts with the selected variant.
The selected run output directory already exists.
The output name supplies an imputation-awareness hint.
A PhaseAware representative option was specified more than once.
A PhaseAware representative does not match its required role.
A requested strategy ID is not in the strategy registry.
The requested behavioral surface is not registered.
Timeline export requires an active dynamic selector.
The recommendation limit must be a positive integer.
